page_title: Kīlauea Volcano — Fissure 8 Flow: From Vent to Sea | U.S. Geological Survey
contents: Helicopter overflight, June 14 2018: fountaining at fissure 8 (~8–20 s), channel snaking downslope (~20–36 s), then the ocean entry with laze plumes and littoral explosions (~36–98 s).
